title: Benchmark record
description: One timing campaign for one build/variant. Emitted by shared/scripts/bench.py. A speedup claim without a matching record from both sides is not reportable.

reps.description: Minimum 5. Fewer does not support a significance claim.

warmup_discarded.description: Reps run and discarded before measuring.

interleaved_with.description: Label of the record this one was A/B interleaved against. Null means sequential blocks - drift is a confound; say so.

samples_s.description: Every measured wall time, in order. Never pre-filtered.

rel_mad.description: mad_s / median_s. Above ~0.05 the machine is noisy.

ci95_s.description: [low, high] bootstrap CI on the median.

speedup.description: Present only when a baseline record was supplied.

ci95.description: [low, high] bootstrap CI on the speedup ratio.

significant.description: True only when the CI excludes 1.0. False means the variant did nothing measurable.

practically_significant.description: True only when the whole CI clears the declared practical threshold in either direction.

conditions.description: What must match between compared records. A mismatch invalidates the comparison.

launch_shape.description: ranks x threads x gpus x nodes.

failures.description: Non-zero exits or oracle failures during the campaign, with rep index.
